title: Operations Operator
subtitle: A 30-day AI operator pass for SOP design, execution handoffs, recurring cadences, and cleaner team follow-through.
descriptionBody:
Operations pain rarely looks dramatic at first. It shows up as loose handoffs, invisible blockers, repeated clarifications, and decisions that never quite turn into reliable execution.

Operations Operator is built for teams that need more structure without building a giant process layer. The pass gives teams 30 days of access plus included shared-wallet credits to map workflows, define ownership, tighten recurring cadences, and turn messy execution into something more repeatable.
section1Title: The operating glue for growing teams
section1Body: As teams grow, good people still lose time to unclear ownership, inconsistent process, and meetings that do not produce useful next steps. Operations Operator focuses on the practical side of execution: who owns what, what the workflow is, where handoffs break, and what rhythm keeps the system moving.

features.name: Workflow and SOP mapping
features.desc: Helps document the real sequence of work so repeatable processes become easier to run and improve.

features.name: Ownership and handoff clarity
features.desc: Surfaces unclear responsibility boundaries and defines tighter handoffs across team members.

features.name: Cadence design
features.desc: Structures recurring reviews, operating meetings, and check-ins around actual execution needs.

features.name: Bottleneck diagnosis
features.desc: Identifies where work stalls, loops, or gets re-explained so the team can remove friction faster.

whoThisIsFor: Founders who feel execution quality slipping as the team grows.
Early operators formalizing internal systems without overcomplicating them.
Teams with recurring handoff confusion across functions.
Startups that need a more dependable weekly operating rhythm.

faq.q: Is this only for big teams?
faq.a: No. It is especially useful for small teams where process is starting to matter but a heavy operations stack would be overkill.
Operations Operator is sold as a 30-day access pass with included credits rather than a one-time lifetime purchase.

faq.q: Can it act as HR or support?
faq.a: It can support structured HR, support, and operations workflows, with external actions kept approval-gated as integrations mature.
